mapper.select: SELECT T.DATA_VERSION, T.PARAMS, CASE WHEN T.STATUS = 3 THEN 2 /*处理失败*/ WHEN COUNT(1) > 1 THEN 1 /*处理成功*/ ELSE 3 /*处理中*/ END STATUS, T.MSG FROM AUX_REQ_SYNC_DATA_LOGS T LEFT JOIN AUX_REQ_SYNC_DATA_LOGS_HIS H ON T.DATA_VERSION = H.DATA_VERSION WHERE T.DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion} GROUP BY T.DATA_VERSION, T.STATUS, T.PARAMS, T.MSG

SELECT T.DATA_VERSION, T.PARAMS, CASE WHEN T.STATUS = 3 THEN 2 /*处理失败*/ WHEN T.STATUS in (1, 2, 6) THEN 1 /*处理成功*/ ELSE 3 /*处理中*/ END STATUS, T.MSG FROM AUX_REQ_SYNC_DATA_LOGS T WHERE T.DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion} GROUP BY T.DATA_VERSION, T.STATUS, T.PARAMS, T.MSG
